description: Default capability set for the main window. Note on opener:allow-open-url: this may be redundant, since the Rust-side app.opener().open_url() call in auth/flow.rs appears to bypass this scope check entirely. It is kept because the login flow has only been verified working with it present — do not remove it without re-verifying login, and do not 'fix' any resulting gap by adding a URL-scope wildcard.
